narr: This is Voxura. An AI calling platform that helps businesses reach every lead, in their own language, and turn conversations into customers.

title: One connected system for every lead

cards.p: Website, ads, Excel sheets, phone enquiries
Every lead needs a call, in the right language
Promised callbacks slip through the cracks

end: Voxura brings all of it into one place
narr: Every business faces the same problem. Leads arrive from many places. Calling each one takes hours. And follow-ups get forgotten. Voxura brings all of it into one connected system.
From the customer's side, Voxura works in six simple steps. Set up once. Add your leads. Start a campaign. Let the AI agent call. Follow up. And win the customer.
Behind these six steps are two flows. The setup flow is done only once. The daily flow repeats every day. Let's walk through both, step by step.

title: Setup flow
narr: First, the setup flow.

title: Create the company account
steps: Enter company, owner, email, mobile, password
sys: Private workspace created · you become the Owner
narr: Step one. The business creates its account. It enters the company name, the owner's details and a password. Voxura creates a private workspace for that company, and the person who signs up becomes the owner. Every company sees only its own data.

title: Add money to the wallet
steps: Pick an amount, or type one
sys: Balance and ledger saved together · every call charged once
narr: Step two. Add money to the wallet. Voxura is prepaid. Every top-up and every call charge is written to a ledger, so the balance always matches the history. A low-balance alert warns the team before the money runs out. Online payment will be connected before go-live.

title: Get a business phone number
steps: Voxura adds numbers to a central pool
sys: Lines, monthly rent and renewal date shown · one answering agent per number
narr: Step three. Get a business phone number. Voxura's team adds numbers to a central pool and assigns one to the company. The company then sees its lines, the monthly rent and the renewal date, and chooses which AI agent answers incoming calls.

title: Add services and products
steps: Decide if the AI may quote the price
Set when to offer it and the next step
sys: Linked to the agents that may sell it
narr: Step four. Add services and products. For each one, the business decides what the AI may say about the price, when to offer it, and what the next step should be, such as booking a demo.

title: Create the AI agent
steps: What to say: greeting and instructions
Advanced: recording, memory, calls at once
sys: Agent ready for campaigns and callbacks
narr: Step five. Create the AI agent, in six short steps. Give it a name and a purpose. Write what it should say. Choose what it may sell. Add company knowledge and common questions. Pick one of eleven Indian languages and a voice. Then set options like call recording and memory.

title: Invite the team · Connect lead sources
steps: Invite team members with a role
Connect website, Facebook, Google Ads, IndiaMART
New leads then arrive by themselves
sys: Designed and approved · next to build
narr: Steps six and seven are designed, and come next. The owner will invite team members with roles, and connect lead sources like the website, Facebook, Google Ads and IndiaMART, so that new leads arrive automatically.

title: Ready to call
sub: The AI agent can start working
narr: With setup complete, the AI agent is ready to start calling.

title: Daily flow
narr: Now, the daily flow. This is what the team does every day.

title: Start the day on the Dashboard
sys: Every figure opens the full page in one click
narr: The day starts on the dashboard. In one view, the team sees the wallet balance, calls and minutes, the running campaign, and the follow-ups that are due or overdue. Every figure opens the full page with one click.

title: Add new leads
steps: Type in a lead, or import from Excel
Six stages, from New to Won
narr: Next, leads are added. When a lead is saved, Voxura cleans the phone number into one standard format and blocks duplicates. Each lead then moves across six stages, from New to Won, on a simple board.

title: Import thousands from Excel
steps: Choose an Excel or CSV file
sys: Up to 10,000 rows · one click to call them in a campaign
narr: Thousands of leads can be imported from Excel at once. Voxura finds the right columns, shows a preview of valid, invalid and repeated rows, and never overwrites an existing lead. One click then sends the new leads into a campaign.

title: Create a campaign
steps: Choose who to call: stage, city, owner
See count, cost and wallet check
sys: 7 leads will be called · estimated ₹53 · wallet ₹980.92
narr: Then a campaign is created. The team picks the AI agent, and chooses who to call, by stage, city or owner. Voxura instantly shows how many people will be called, the estimated cost, and whether the wallet is enough. Do-not-disturb numbers are skipped by default.

title: Timing and campaign status
steps: Retries and the gap between them
narr: The team sets the start time, the daily calling hours, how many calls run at once, and how many retries to make. A campaign moves from draft, to scheduled, to running, and finally to completed. It can be paused, restarted, or cancelled at any time.

title: The AI makes the call
narr: Now the AI makes the call. Before dialling, it checks the calling hours, do-not-disturb, the wallet, and the call limit. During the call, it listens, understands, and replies in the chosen language, using only the company's approved information. After the call, it saves the recording, the transcript and the outcome, charges the talk time once, and schedules a retry or a callback if needed. This live voice connection is the next build step, once the provider accounts are ready.

title: Check the call results
steps: Filter by result, outcome, agent, date
Open a call: summary and conversation
See talk time, rate and charge
narr: Every call appears in call history, with names instead of codes. Opening a call shows the result, the summary, the conversation, and exactly what it cost. Unanswered calls are never charged.

title: Follow up: callbacks and tasks
steps: Or a callback the AI will make
sys: Late items surface on the dashboard
narr: Follow-ups make sure no lead is forgotten. A follow-up can be a task for a team member, or a callback that the AI will make. They are sorted into overdue, today and upcoming, and late items appear on the dashboard.

title: Move the lead to Won
steps: Update the stage as the deal moves
sys: Customer won · the cycle repeats tomorrow
narr: Finally, the team moves the lead forward, stage by stage, until the customer is won. And the next day, the cycle begins again.

title: Rules that run on every action
narr: Behind every screen, business rules run automatically. Phone numbers are cleaned. Duplicates are blocked. Do-not-disturb is respected. Costs are checked before a campaign starts. Each call is charged only once. And every company's data stays private. Scheduled automation, such as reminders and emails, comes with the next phase.

title: Everyone sees what they need
narr: Access is controlled by role. Owners and admins manage agents, campaigns and money. Staff work with leads and tasks. These rules are checked on the server, for every single action.

title: Running the platform
sys: Designed · the number pool is already built
narr: Voxura's own team runs the platform from the Super Admin. It is designed to manage client companies, plans and prices, wallets with a second approval, provider costs and margin, and a complete audit log. The phone number pool is already built.

title: Built, tested and designed
narr: So far, twelve modules are built and working, covering forty-two workflows, and verified by two hundred and eighty-five automated checks. Fifty-seven screens are designed for the complete platform.
Voxura. Set up once, and grow every day.
